author: Inside Edition
description: An elderly couple fell victim to a Tom Selleck imposter. Karen and Donald Whitaker were found dead in their Palm Springs home in what police say appeared to be a murder-suicide triggered by the realization that they had lost a chunk of their life savings to a person who impersonated actor Tom Selleck. Karen, 79, sent money to the online scammer who was posing as the "Magnum PI" and "Blue Bloods" star. Inside Edition's Jim Moret spoke to the couples' friend Joy Miedecke.
title: Elderly Couple Found Dead Were Victims To Scam By Tom Selleck Impersonator: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: At only 7 years old Joey Evermore is the youngest climber to reach the top of El Capitan, the iconic 3,000-foot rock formation in Yosemite National Park. Evermore navigated El Capitan's vertical wall, with a little help from his dad, Joe. After reaching the summit, the boy waved at the camera just for Inside Edition. Joe spoke with Inside Edition's Steven Fabian.
title: 7-Year-Old Boy Becomes Youngest Climber To Reach Top Of El Capitan

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump announced he is rolling back regulations on supermarket refrigerators in a major press conference in the Oval Office. But, all many are talking about is the bulging belly button over the president's shoulder. The belly button belongs to Ron Graf Sr., and he is the co-owner of a chain of supermarkets in Ohio. Inside Edition reached out to the Graf family and his granddaughter said, "He has a hernia which causes that bulge in his belly button." Inside Edition spoke with New York surgeon, Dr. Mark Reiner.
title: Man's Belly Button Steals Show At President Trump's Press Conference

author: Inside Edition
description:
In November 2025, Kyle Busch and his wife, Samantha Busch sat down with Eva Pilgrim for an extended interview about the investment they say turned into a financial nightmare.

The couple claims they were misled into putting millions into an indexed universal life insurance policy they believed would secure their future after racing.

In court filings, both Pacific Life and the Buschs’ former insurance agent deny wrongdoing. Pacific Life tells Inside Edition it stands behind its products and says it has helped millions of families plan for financial security.
title: Extended Cut: Eva Pilgrim's sit-down with Kyle and Samantha Busch

author: Inside Edition
description: Racecar driver Kyle Busch has died. NASCAR and his family released a statement saying he passed suddenly from a severe illness, but did not elaborate. Busch won more races than any other driver across NASCAR's three national series, including two CUP Series. He was set to compete in the Coca-Cola 600, but was hospitalized a few days before the event. Fans and fellow drivers are mourning this unexpected loss.
title: NASCAR Champion Kyle Busch Dies Suddenly At 41

author: Inside Edition
description: Officers who fought to defend the Capital on January 6th now have another fight on their hands,  to stop the pardoned members of the riot from receiving part of a $1.7 billion dollar Anti-Weaponization Fund. The fund is the result of a settlement between President Trump and the IRS over Trump’s claim that a government contractor leaked his tax returns. The President says the government should not be weaponized against the American people. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 2 January 6th Officers File Lawsuit To Stop Trump's Anti-Weaponization Fund
